sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Worst Job in the World is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Hello mercenary! You know, the job of a peacekeeper is a very difficult one. Peacekeepers are expected to strike a strict balance between the warring parties, and often we find ourselves in the worst kinds of situations. In general, the UN is as interested in a speedy resolution of the conflict as the local authorities. But the local criminal elements are making it difficult. So my superiors require me to achieve new results in the fight against the looters. But how can I do it without casualties among the UN forces? Do you see where I'm going with this?"

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - Must be Loyalty Level 4 to start this quest

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate any 30 enemies from over 100 meters away while using AR-15 platform weapons on Reserve, Lighthouse, Shoreline, or Ground Zero

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +65,000 EXP
- Peacekeeper Rep +1.5
- 2,750 Dollars
  - 2,888 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 3,162 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 1x Armband (USEC)
- Unlocks barter for M203 40mm underbarrel grenade launcher at Peacekeeper LL3
- Unlocks purchase of 40x46mm M386 (HE) grenade at Peacekeeper LL3
- Unlock purchase of Team Wendy EXFIL Ballistic Helmet (Black) at Peacekeeper LL4
- Unlock craft for .300 Blackout AP in the Hideout
- +4 levels in DMRs
- +2 levels in Aim Drills
"You did it? Well done! It's all about the greater good!"

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
In this quest you have to kill any 30 hostiles from a distance of over 100m with AR-15 platform weapons. You can use any of the following:
- M4A1
- ADAR 2-15
- TX-15 DML
- Radian Model 1
- M16A1
- M16A2

A recommendable spot to shoot from would be dome area on Reserve as you can get a good view of the Scav spawns around the map.

It is recommended to use a suppressor as shooting loud from this position can attract unwanted attention.

AI Scavs tend to search and loot dead bodies. For a brief moment they will be stationary whilst looting, allowing for an easy headshot kill. Killing targets out in the open will leave their bodies as bait allowing for AI or players to loot them letting you gain more kills and establishing areas of interest to shoot at.

Use a high zoom variable scope for better accuracy and non-tracer ammunition for better concealment.
